meta.title: hwe — Living, elegantly
meta.description: Find a home, rent out or sell your property directly or with a professional, and keep track of leases and rents online.
hero.title2: on your own or with an agent.
hero.sub: Direct contact with the landlord or their agency, lease signed online, rents and receipts tracked. Find your next address {place}.
dest.desc: Pick a city to see its listings.
cat.descCity: Everything for rent or sale in {city}.
steps.desc: From the search to the keys.
steps.1.title: Search
steps.1.desc: Filter by city, budget and property type. Save your favorites in your space.
steps.2.title: Visit
steps.2.desc: Message the landlord, or the agency managing the property, directly and request a visit online.
steps.3.title: Sign
steps.3.desc: Digital lease signed remotely, application shared in one click.
steps.4.title: Move in
steps.4.desc: Check-in report, handing over the keys, rents and receipts tracked in your space.
hero.visualAlt: A family in their new home
ben.desc: Built for Africa and Europe: in French, English, Spanish, Portuguese or Arabic, with prices converted into your currency.
ben.1.title: Free for individuals
ben.1.desc: Landlords and tenants use hwe with no platform fees or commission. Only professionals who manage properties pay a subscription.
ben.2.title: Well-equipped landlords
ben.2.desc: Listings, visits, leases and rents are managed from a single dashboard — by you, or by a professional you entrust the property to.
ben.3.title: Everything online, safely
ben.3.desc: Application, lease signed remotely, receipts: your documents stay in your space.
cta.title: Your next address
cta.sub: Favorites, direct contact with landlords and agencies, lease signed online and rents tracked. Sign up in a minute.
pro.title: Are you a professional?
pro.sub: Manage your clients' properties on hwe: the landlord follows everything from their space, you handle the rest.
pro.p1.title: Portfolio and team
pro.p1.desc: All your mandates in one place, shared out among your agents.
pro.p2.title: The landlord approves
pro.p2.desc: You propose the tenant and prepare the lease; they approve and sign in one click.
pro.p3.title: Fees calculated for you
pro.p3.desc: Management, letting or sale: amounts tracked, with monthly PDF statements.

pro.pricing.subTrial: Every feature for {trialDuration}, then the plan of your choice. The agency pays: never the landlord or the tenant.
pro.pricing.subNoTrial: Choose the plan that suits you. The agency pays: never the landlord or the tenant.
